爱莎贝儿2026.11月广州成人展之旅圆满落幕！

这几天展台一直热热闹闹，真的超级开心能和这么多小伙伴线下见面！
感谢大家专程过来打卡、凑近细细欣赏我们的娃娃，愿意停下来和我们聊天，
分享自己喜欢的风格、在意的小细节。好多朋友热情地和我们分享想法，
不管是夸赞，还是提出想要改进的小建议，我们全都好好收下、认真记好啦。

看着大家看到新崽崽时眼睛发亮的样子，就是我们埋头创作最大的快乐！
这次也认识了不少同好和行业伙伴，聊了很多有意思的想法，收获满满。

现在展会告一段落，展台收拾完毕，我们要暂时回归工坊，开启新一轮的打磨计划咯。
大家期待的新造型、想要优化的细节，我们都会慢慢安排，用心调整。

短暂分别不是结束，是蓄力准备新惊喜的开始！我们会继续努力做出更多好看、
精致的娃娃，期待下一次展会，再和大家愉快碰面

Elsa Babe's Guangzhou Adult Products Expo 2026 November Trip Concludes Successfully!

The booth was bustling with activity these past few days, and we were incredibly happy to meet so many friends in person!

Thank you all for making the trip to visit, get up close and admire our dolls, and stop to chat with us, sharing your favorite styles and the little details you care about. Many friends enthusiastically shared their thoughts with us, whether it was praise or suggestions for improvement—we carefully accepted and remembered them all.

Seeing everyone's eyes light up when they saw our new dolls was our greatest joy while we were creating!

We also met many like-minded people and industry partners, discussed many interesting ideas, and gained a lot.

Now that the expo has come to an end and the booth is packed up, we're temporarily returning to our workshop to begin a new round of refinement.

We will gradually work on the new designs and details that everyone has been looking forward to, making careful adjustments.

This short separation is not the end, but the beginning of preparing for new surprises! We will continue to work hard to make more beautiful and exquisite dolls, and we look forward to meeting everyone again at the next exhibition.
